questions.description: Strings in Java are called immutable. What does this property mean?

questions.Option2: A String cannot be passed as a method parameter

questions.Option4: A String variable cannot be assigned a different value later

questions.title: Why StringBuilder Is Preferred in Loops
questions.description: Why is StringBuilder usually preferred over String concatenation when building a large text inside a loop?

questions.Option3: String concatenation is forbidden inside loops
